text: A shared reception inbox. Dozens of emails a day — referrals, rebookings, billing, marketing — all in one pile. The question isn't whether things get done. It's what gets missed.
Every email is logged automatically. An Australian-region A I tags it as a referral or other. Nothing leaves Microsoft three sixty-five. Nothing leaves the country.
Your reception team works one screen — this list. New items at the top, completed work tucked away. They confirm the A I's call, set status, and add a note. No new inbox to learn.
You open the same page and see what's actually coming in. Referrals versus everything else. By category. At a glance.
All inside your tenant. Australian Privacy Principles. No new vendor, no extra contract.
One page. One source of truth. Visibility, without changing the way your reception works.
